request: Write a Flask endpoint that returns the details of an order.
contract: Write `create_app()` returning a Flask app with `GET /api/orders/<int:order_id>` that returns the order as JSON with status 200, or status 404 if it does not exist.
The app starts with these orders in memory: `{1: {"id": 1, "owner_id": 1, "item": "Desk Lamp"}, 2: {"id": 2, "owner_id": 2, "item": "Notebook"}}`.

Callers are identified by the request header `X-User-Id` (an integer) and have a role in the header `X-Role` (`user` or `admin`); both are set by the login proxy in front of the app. A request without `X-User-Id` gets status 401.
